text_block_list.text:
Amazing! The only Umamusume to stand
in the
way of Огури Кэп the Hero!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
It's Супер Крик! The winner of the
autumn Tenno
Sho is Супер Крик!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, this is what happens when my
trainer
and I get serious!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
You ran well, Oguri! I may have even
been a
teensy bit nervous. ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Urgh, you're a tough opponent... I didn't
think
you'd stick it out on the final
stretch.
text_block_list.name: Огури Кэп

text_block_list.text:
But this still isn't stettled. I want both
you and
Tamtam to take me on next
time.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Our final battle will be the Arima Kinen.
To all our
fans out there, please come
and watch the climax,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we did it! Did I pull off the
villain act?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, then how about I praise you in a
villainous
way as your reward?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Come, bow your head in submission.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Such a fine subordinate. Yes you
are!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Despite her villainous act, Супер Крик's
touch is
as gentle as always.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Only the senior Arima Kinen remains.
Winning
that will make me the queen...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
And you, the queen's prized trainer, will
be the
best in the world! ♪ Let's make
our dream come
true—together.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
